reason: Public pause/edit synchronization and accumulation semantics are unresolved. Native set_pause is asynchronous and wait is a job-completion wait.
recommended: Preserve native ordinary pause; synchronously cancel/wait before first edit of paused running session; require reset before resume.
tradeoffs: cannot resume interrupted accumulation after edits
native-style locking would weaken strict no-rendering promise
acknowledged native pause may need separately authorized internal change
